5. Emotional Biases: Emotions can influence decision-making, and considering all options can bring up various emotions, making it challenging to remain objective. Emotional biases can lead to irrational decisions or the elimination of options based on emotions rather than rational analysis.

To mitigate the limitations of considering all options in decision making, individuals can use various strategies such as prioritizing options, breaking down complex decisions into smaller parts, seeking external expertise, or using decision-making tools and frameworks.
